validationRepairs.failure: Existing question-revision UI test exceeded the unchanged 5000ms timeout during the full parallel suite.
validationRepairs.interpretation: The isolated pass suggests a load-sensitive timeout; no assertion failure or application defect was reproduced by isolation.
validationRepairs.correction: Bound test file workers to 2. Keep the original timeout and all assertions. Rebuild first, then run the full suite.
